tha-ap54:1.1: Sataraṃsika.] Ubbiddhaṃ selam āruyha nisīdi purisuttamo / pabbatassāvidūramhi brāhmaṇo mantapāragū. // //
tha-ap54:2.1: Upaviṭṭhaṃ mahāvīraṃ devadevaṃ narāsabhaṃ / añjalim paggahetvāna santhaviṃ lokanāyakaṃ: // //
tha-ap54:3.1: ‘Esa Buddho mahā*vīro varadhammappakāsako / jala*ti aggikkhandho 'va bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato. // //
tha-ap54:4.1: Mahāsamuddo 'va 'kkhobbho aṇṇavo vā duruttaro / migarājā v' asambhīto dhammaṃ deseti cakkhumā.' // //
tha-ap54:5.1: Mama saṅkappam aññāya Padumuttaranāyako / bhikkhusaṅghe ṭhito *satthā imā gāthā abhāsatha:* // //
tha-ap54:6.1: ‘Yenāyaṃ añjali dinno Buddhaseṭṭho ca thomito / tiṃsakappasahassāni devarajjaṃ karissati. // //
tha-ap54:7.1: Kappasatasahassamhi Aṅgīrasassanāmako / vivattachaddo sambu*ddho uppajjissati tāvade.* // //
tha-ap54:8.1: Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito / Sataraṃsī ti nāmena arahā so bhavissati.' // //
tha-ap54:9.1: Jātiyā sattavasso 'haṃ pabbajjiṃ anagāriyaṃ / Sataraṃsī pi nāmena *pabhā niddhāvate mama.* // //
tha-ap54:10.1: Maṇḍape rukkhamūle vā jhāyī jhānarato ahaṃ / dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsane. // //
tha-ap54:12.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap54:13.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sataraṃsiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
